info.name: Adroit Platform API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Adroit Multi-Tenant Cloud Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).

Features automated token extraction, dynamic environment variable updates, and complete coverage of API Gateway, Auth Service, and User/Workspace microservices.
